Run Automatic Barcoding Gap Discovery (ABGD)

abgd_execute.Rd

Run Automatic Barcoding Gap Discovery (ABGD)

Usage

abgd_execute(
  alignment,
  exe,
  output_folder = NULL,
  a = T,
  p = 0.001,
  P = 0.1,
  n = 20,
  d = 3,
  X = 1.5,
  args = NULL,
  overwrite = F
)

Arguments

alignment

Character. Path to the input FASTA alignment file.

exe

Character. Path to the ABGD executable.

output_folder

Character or NULL. Output directory path. Defaults to file.path(dirname(alignment), "ABGD").

a

Logical. Whether to pass -a to ABGD. Default is TRUE.

p

Numeric. Minimum a priori intraspecific divergence (Pmin). Default is 0.001.

P

Numeric. Maximum a priori intraspecific divergence (Pmax). Default is 0.1.

n

Integer. Number of steps in [Pmin, Pmax]. Default is 20.

d

Integer. Genetic distance option: 0 = Kimura-2P, 1 = Jukes-Cantor, 2 = Tamura-Nei, 3 = simple p-distance. Default is 3.

X

Numeric. Minimum relative gap width / slope increase (X). Default is 1.5.

args

Character or NULL. Additional CLI arguments passed to ABGD. Default is NULL.

overwrite

Logical. Whether to overwrite output_folder if it already contains files. Default is FALSE.

Value

Character path to output_folder.
